issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按源码第一个数字猜成 54f——卡片刚扫到出画就结束，切后的 B 页没有任何停留
遮挡卡和背景页同为浅色，失焦糊满时整屏是一片发灰的白，读不出“有东西贴着镜头掠过”
±40px 带风推挤把页面整体平移，切后左缘露出一条米灰底色缝（侧栏外侧），魔术当场穿帮
推挤是切点前后各自孤立的两小段运动，镜头其余时间完全死机位，“一条 take”的错觉不牢
前景卡扫过时对背景没有任何光影影响，近物与远景之间没有距离感
changes: 补 INVISIBLE_CUT_DURATION = 100（前态 40 + 横扫 14 + 回稳/静止 46）；1600×1000·scale 1.6、-2200→2600 共 14f bezier(0.3,0,0.7,1)、f47 切点、CameraMotionBlur 300°/12、4 层残影、±40 推挤全部保持
遮挡卡改用 Card tone="dark" 深色版：离镜头最近、不受光的前景读作暗剪影，糊满帧是一拍“被挡住”的暗，切点更隐形；主卡加 0 40px 120px 深色投影
前景卡前缘挂一条 900px 宽的软投影带（0.9→0 线性渐隐，整体 0.32）随卡扫过背景，近物遮光卖出贴脸距离感
背景页左右各接 64px 延展边（左接侧栏深色渐变、右接顶栏 #fafaf9 + 内容区底色），推挤与横移不再露底
加一条贯穿切点的慢速相机横移（0–85f 共 -18px，EASE.smooth），切前切后是同一个运动；85f 后完全停稳留 15f 静止收尾
issuesEn: No duration constant; the workbench guessed 54f from the first number in the source, so the shot ended the instant the card left frame and scene B never held
The occluding card and the page were both light, so the defocused full-cover frames were a flat greyish white — nothing read as an object brushing past the lens
The ±40px wind shove translated the whole page and exposed a beige strip at the left edge after the cut, breaking the trick
The shove was two isolated moves around the cut with a dead-locked camera otherwise, so the one-take illusion was weak
The passing foreground card had no light/shadow effect on the background, so there was no sense of depth between near and far
changesEn: Added INVISIBLE_CUT_DURATION = 100 (40 lead-in + 14 sweep + 46 settle/hold); the 1600×1000 ·1.6 card, -2200→2600 over 14f with bezier(0.3,0,0.7,1), f47 cut, CameraMotionBlur 300°/12, four trails and ±40 shove are unchanged

The occluder now uses Card tone="dark": the nearest, unlit foreground reads as a dark silhouette, so the full-cover frames are a beat of being blocked and the cut hides better; the main card gets a 0 40px 120px dark shadow
A 900px soft shadow band (0.9→0 gradient at 0.32) rides the card's leading edge across the background, selling how close it passes
The page now has 64px bleed extensions on both sides (sidebar gradient on the left, #fafaf9 top bar plus canvas on the right), so the shove and drift never reveal the backdrop
A slow camera drift runs through the cut (-18px over 0–85f, EASE.smooth), so before and after are one continuous move; everything is still after 85f, leaving a 15f hold
